shadowSentences: I love to read books every day.
She enjoys cooking new recipes at home.
They went hiking in the mountains last weekend.
He plays soccer with his friends every Saturday.
We often visit the local farmers' market for fresh produce.
My favorite hobby is painting landscapes in my free time.
I started learning a new language during the pandemic.
Traveling to new countries opens my mind to different cultures.
Studying history helps me understand the world better.
Volunteering at the local shelter has been a rewarding experience.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you had?
Q2: What are some challenges you face when planning a trip?
Q3: How important do you think travel is for personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip abroad?
